svg.title: Promote with failure-back-to-review loop, post-approve fan-out to export, FHIR, search, audit, and the two cross-cutting billing gaps
svg.desc: Promote runs the audited action through migration 030; on failure the UI shows NOT filed and returns to review; on success the document links to patient and encounter and fans out to export, FHIR push, semantic search, and audit trail. Billing is cross-cutting with two red gaps: page-credit metering not enforced and subscription lifecycle not synced.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does promote persist and what is the class-3 prescriber fix in migration 030?')
sendPrompt('What is the promotion-fail loop and Fix B, the NOT filed message?')
sendPrompt('How is the document linked to patient and encounter after promote?')
sendPrompt('How does the export bundle work — JSON, CSV, FHIR?')
sendPrompt('How does optional FHIR push to an external system work?')
sendPrompt('How does semantic search over validated documents work?')
sendPrompt('What is recorded in the audit trail?')

svg.text: Cross-cutting: billing — not covered for a scaled customer

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why is page-credit metering not enforced and what does it need?')
g.text: Placeholder only — a practice can upload unlimited pages
regardless of plan. Founder-pilot tolerable; must build
before billing at scale or margin is uncontrolled.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why is subscription lifecycle not synced and what does the Paystack webhook need to do?')
g.text: Entitlement set once manually; no Paystack webhook for
renew, cancel or lapse. Same webhook as self-serve
sign-up — both are the build-before-scale items.
